hall.sub: Go with us to become a Cybersecurity Champion — four chapters, four habits.
hall.artNote: Semi-realistic illustrated style (not photoreal). A man and a woman standing side by side in a heroic 3/4 pose, wearing P&G-logo jackets, lit with a cyan rim-light against the star field. Shield and padlock motifs float behind them. Export at 1800×800 @2x, transparent PNG.
hall.chooseSub: One chapter unlocks each week. Complete all four to become a Champion.
hall.rule.retry: Retry as many times as you like
hall.demo.label: Demo controls:
kpi.completed.label: People completed
kpi.plays.label: Total plays
chapter.1.title: Safe Account
chapter.1.desc: Keep your account safe and secured
chapter.1.stage: A neon chase across a data-centre corridor: the P&G hero advances left-to-right while a hooded hacker retreats into the dark. A 5-step progress track runs between them; each correct answer closes the gap by one step.
chapter.2.title: Safe Device
chapter.2.stage: A shield-wall defence scene: the hero raises a glowing barrier around laptops and phones while malware shards strike it. Each correct answer seals one more device.
chapter.3.title: Safe Connection
chapter.3.desc: Connect to the system by secured ways
chapter.3.stage: A bridge-building scene across a dark data chasm: each correct answer lays one encrypted span so the hero can cross to the secure server node.
chapter.4.title: Safe Installation
chapter.4.stage: A vault-assembly scene: the hero slots authorised software modules into a glowing vault while rogue installers are rejected at the gate.
ch.answersNote: Answers are shuffled every play. Incorrect answers are not revealed — retry the chapter to improve your score.
result.win.title: Champion! Hacker captured.
result.win.sub: Perfect run — you locked every door before the hacker got through.
result.win.note: The hero catches the hacker mid-stride and locks a glowing cyan restraint around them. Confetti bursts from the top of the frame. Bright, celebratory rim-lighting.
result.partial.title: The hacker got away — try again.
result.partial.sub: You scored {score} out of {total}. Retry as many times as you like to reach a perfect run.
result.partial.note: The hacker dissolves into the dark at the right edge of the frame, trailing red glitch particles. The hero stands in the foreground, dimmer and unlit. Cool, subdued lighting.
result.bravoTop3: Perfect score recorded. Your best run for this chapter is saved.
result.bravoKeep: Every attempt is saved — play again any time to beat your best.
game.hotspot.summary: You found {n} of {total}. The rest are circled in amber — take a look before moving on.
game.story.summary: You made the right call {n} of {total} times. All three are needed for the point.
game.story.winScene: Reported, contained, and the team is safe. That is exactly how it should go.
game.story.missScene: The email is handled — but a couple of steps could have gone better.
ch.saveFailed: Your score could not be saved — showing your result anyway.
ch.loadFailed: This chapter could not be loaded. Check that the server is running, then refresh.
ch.graceNotice: This chapter has closed. This is your final play — leave without retrying and it locks.
ch.blocked.title: This chapter is locked
ch.blocked.upcoming: This chapter has not opened yet. Come back on its unlock date.
ch.blocked.window-closed: Its week has ended and you have already played it. Your best score is saved.
ch.blocked.grace-used: Its week has ended and your final play has been used.
ch.blocked.no-content: This chapter is still being built. Check back soon.
ch.blocked.closed: This chapter is no longer available.
ch.blocked.unknown: This chapter could not be found.
